WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    ram.ordervault,
    u.acctscope,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM riskandmargin ram
  JOIN orders o ON ram.ordervault = o.recordvault
  JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY ram.ordervault, u.acctscope
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    acctscope,
    SUM(cnt) as total
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY acctscope
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(total) as grand_total
  FROM step2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT 
    s2.acctscope,
    s2.total,
    CAST(s2.total AS FLOAT) / s3.grand_total as ratio
  FROM step2 s2
  CROSS JOIN step3 s3
  WHERE s3.grand_total IS NOT NULL
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(total) as avg_total
  FROM step4
)
SELECT 
  s4.acctscope,
  s4.total,
  s4.ratio,
  CAST(s4.total AS FLOAT) / s5.avg_total as total_over_avg
FROM step4 s4
CROSS JOIN step5 s5
WHERE s5.avg_total IS NOT NULL
